$comment: Pins every plugin embedded into the published CLI tarball. embed-plugin.mjs asserts the built artefact hashes against this lock on every build; release.yml checks out the pinned commit instead of default-branch HEAD. Bumping a plugin = update commit + artefact hashes here in a reviewed alter-cli PR (clean-build the pinned commit, `sha256sum main.js manifest.json styles.css`). Born from the 2026-06-05 v0.8.10 divergence: desk gates scanned a stale sibling's 23.5KB bundle while CI published a 34.2KB bundle built from unpinned plugin HEAD.
